caption: The drawing features a central white hexagonal area containing cursive text, surrounded by a wreath composed of green leaves with subtle blue tips. Encircling the wreath is a border of three-dimensional cube shapes arranged in a honeycomb pattern. Each cube is divided into three parallelograms, and their surfaces are decorated with various patterns and colors including green, pink, black, brown, red, blue, and cream. Some faces have floral motifs in colors such as blue, pink, green, and white, while others display stripes, abstract designs, or solid colored sections. The entire composition is framed by a plain cream-colored background.
title: Patchwork Quilt
